cases.sourceTrace: C alreadynamed recognizes actual Juiblex and case-insensitive exact Jubilex and emits the specific rejection. Current accepted JS instead emits the generic unique-monster refusal. The C message-selection behavior is established; the hidden JS predicate explanation is inference, not an observed fact.
